title: El Paso Museum of Art
geometryBasis: OpenStreetMap way 262818915 supplies the 20-corner museum perimeter. Main entrance node 4059893039 aligns the recessed plaza entrance and the photographed perpendicular wing.
sectionBasis: The exact published public-domain Qualla exterior is dated to 2011. It establishes the pale panel grid, paired glazed entry doors, tall mullioned window, blue side wall and pale overhang. The mapped perimeter fixes the entire gallery footprint. Roof plan, unseen secondary elevations and precise opening sizes and heights are estimates. Artworks, nearby buildings and reflections are outside scope. The original 128 m elevation field remains unchanged. Its plaza contact establishes the approximate entrance grade. The rear walls meet rising terrain without flattening the field. This is a dated 2011 exterior with no source-image pixels or modern alterations.
